task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Catch the paymentsign resting on angled base, pick it up, and rotate to show the QR code.
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。手臂保持高稳定性，不变形，进入框架捕捉位于倾斜底座上的支付标志，将其拿起并旋转以显示二维码。
